title: V.L. Nogovikoff, Applicant To Carry Arms

page_data.en:
S. D. REGI
6629
S. 2, Special Branch, xxxx
April 16, '35.

V.L. Nogovikoff, applicant to carry arms.

With reference to the attached application of Vladimir
Leonidovitch Nogovikoff to carry firearms, enquiries show that this
individual is a Russian born in March 1910 at Buinsk, Simbirsk
Province. His late father was an apothecary by occupation. In
1922 V.L. Nogovikoff arrived at Harbin from Russia together with
his parents. He was educated at the Mixed Middle School and
subsequently at Aksakovsky Middle School, Harbin. In 1923 he
served for about 6 months with the Guard of the Lafa-Harbin
Railway. During December 1933 he arrived at Shanghai from Harbin
and soon afterwards obtained employment as a watchman with the
Machine Shop & Warehouse of Andersen, Mayer & Co., No. 2 Tungliang
Road, where he is still working. He resides with his mother at
No. 115 MacGregor Road. Nothing detrimental is known by this
office against the applicant.

Original on file in
Licensing Section.
page_data.zh:
S. D. REGI
6629
S. 2，特科，xxxx
1935年4月16日。

V.L. Nogovikoff，持枪申请人。

关于附呈的弗拉基米尔·列昂尼多维奇·诺戈维科夫（Vladimir Leonidovitch Nogovikoff）携带枪支的申请，经查，此人系俄罗斯人，1910年3月出生于辛比尔斯克省（Simbirsk Province）布因斯克（Buinsk）。其已故父亲职业为药剂师。1922年，V.L. 诺戈维科夫随父母从俄罗斯抵达哈尔滨。他就读于哈尔滨混合中学，随后就读于哈尔滨阿克萨科夫斯基中学（Aksakovsky Middle School）。1923年，他在拉法—哈尔滨铁路警卫队服役约6个月。1933年12月，他从哈尔滨抵达上海，不久后在铜陵路2号安得生·梅尔公司（Andersen, Mayer & Co.）的机器车间及仓库受雇担任看守，目前仍在此工作。他与母亲同住麦格雷戈路（MacGregor Road）115号。本处未掌握对该申请人不利的任何情况。

原件存于执照科。
